notes:
**Status: pending approval by Christian.** CHR-925 / CHR-907, position revised in CHR-929.

**Decision: toast, not banner.** A non-modal toast in the **upper right corner of the canvas area**, directly below the variant breadcrumb bar. It is `position:absolute` over the stage, so it does not move any layout: the topbar (44), variant bar (36) and panel widths are fixed and the canvas frame sizing/zoom depends on the stage height — a banner row would shift the whole canvas each time it appears or is dismissed. A toast is also calm (one dismissible item, no modal), and the persistent copy of the same information lives in the settings menu "About" row (see `shell-settings-menu` notes), so dismissing the toast loses nothing.

**Position (revised per Christian's comment "This should be in the upper right corner").** Offsets are relative to the screen root (1440x900): `top: 96px` = topbar 44 + variant bar 36 + 16px gap, so it sits below the topbar and the variant bar and never covers the bar or its right-side controls; `right: 296px` = right panel 280 + 16px inset from the canvas area's right edge (the toast's right edge is at x=1144, canvas area ends at x=1160). In the implementation: anchor the toast to the canvas area (stage) container with `top: 16px; right: 16px` below the variant bar. It stays clear of the settings trigger (topbar, far right, x 1400-1428) and of the right panel. Width 360px. If the variant bar is absent (a screen without variants) the same 16px gap applies below the topbar.

**Anatomy.** Padding 12 (right 8), radius.md 10, `chrome-raised`, `chrome-shadow-float`, z 10, `role=status` (announced politely, never steals focus). Row: `upgrade` icon 20px `chrome-accent`; column with title "Artisign 2.2.0 is available" (13px medium) and `chrome-code-field` `compact` (28px, mono 12px) `artisign update` with a copy button (`content_copy` -> `check`); close `chrome-icon-btn` sm (`close`) top right, tooltip "Hide for today" drawn below the button (hover state shown), right-aligned to it, so it never covers the variant bar.

**Behaviour.** Appears once per page load when the daemon reports a newer version; close hides it until the next calendar day (browser-local, stored with the version so a newer release shows it again); no auto-dismiss timer; not shown when the update check is off. Clicking the copy icon copies the command only — no update button (updating is a terminal action, `artisign update` restarts the daemon). Dark: same markup with the dark token group at the root.
